```{r imports}
library(ggplot2)
```

## Including zero results

```{r data}
data <- read.csv('./CHI.csv')

head(data)
```

```{r plot}
ggplot(data, aes(x = seq_along(shortest_path), y = shortest_path, color = majority)) + geom_point() + stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "line", aes(group = majority), size = 1)  +
  labs(x = "Row Number", y = "Shortest Path", title = "Scatterplot with Group Average Line")
```
